title: The strict projection extends the fixed completion unit
statement: Let X,Y be small sites, f their geometric morphism with its algebraic constant coefficient lift, A a commutative ring and I an ideal [def-pur-adic-site-strict-quotient-interface]. For every F in the ordinary unbounded derived module category on X, let t be towerProjection and let a be directLimitIso. Then eta_Y(Rf_*F), followed by Rlim_Y(t_F) and a_(reduction_X F)^(-1), equals Rf_*(eta_X(F)). Here eta is the fixed quotient-tower completion unit [def-pur-strict-quotient-completion-data]. This is an equality of canonical morphisms before any completeness or perfectness assumption.

source.place: Equation 0B56 (equation-projection-formula-map), Tags 0941 (lemma-derived-limit-is-ok) and 0A07 (lemma-Rf-commutes-with-Rlim); augmentation and adjunction-unit normalization.

proof.text: Construct the derived quotient augmentation j as the adjunction transpose of the fixed completion unit under the constant/derived-limit adjunction. Thus the constant/limit unit followed by Rlim(j) equals the completion unit by the hom-equivalence inverse law. On a flat-term K-flat representative, the normalized delta adjunction and quotient-presentation laws identify its transpose with the ordinary cochain augmentation: use ordinaryUnit projections, ordinary_unit_factorization and naturality of limitComparison. Injectivity of the hom equivalence gives the representative factorization.

source.place: Tags 0941 and 099M; ordinary limit unit followed by quotient insertions.

proof.text: The moduleReductionPullIso insertion equation and naturality of pullInsertion prove the ordinary augmentation square. Descend this square on a single flat-term K-flat representative using the normalized full-cochain reductionPullIso equation; then use naturality to transport to every derived object. Inverse image along the constant coefficient ring isomorphism is invertible and natural, by scalarExtensionRingIso. This uses no finite-evaluation conclusion or extra Noetherian hypothesis. The full cochain square uses mapComplexSquare for the constant square and the published moduleReductionPullComplexIso for the reduction square.

source.place: Tags 07A4 and 06YY; pure tensors and universal derived comparisons.

proof.text: Taking adjunction mates gives the strict projection/augmentation square. The unit mate identity and the definition of directLimitIso as the iterated adjunction conjugate give its limit specialization on the constant tower. Naturality moves the X augmentation through directLimitIso; cancel the inverse pair. The result is Rlim(towerProjection) followed by directLimitIso inverse, composed with the Y completion unit, equal to pushforward of the X completion unit. No perfectness or completeness is used. This is the explicit categorical calculation of Mathlib unit_mateEquiv and iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv, not an application of the general ringed tensor projection theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem strictReductionProjectionCompletionUnit (F : X.derived A) :
    (Y.unit A I).app ((f.push A).obj F) ≫
        (Y.rlim A).map (f.towerProjection A I F) ≫
        (f.directLimitIso A).inv.app ((X.reduction A I).obj F) =
      (f.push A).map ((X.unit A I).app F)
